reports.title: Movies Table
reports.query: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS title, m.released AS year LIMIT 5

reports.title: Cast Bar Chart
reports.query: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS label, count(p) AS value ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 5

reports.title: Relationships Pie
reports.query: MATCH ()-[r]->() RETURN type(r) AS name, count(*) AS value

reports.title: Movie Timeline
reports.query: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS task, m.released AS start, m.released + 2 AS end LIMIT 5

reports.title: 3D Network
reports.query: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN p, r, m LIMIT 20

reports.title: Genre Hierarchy
reports.query: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name AS name, count(m) AS value

reports.title: Movies by Country
reports.query: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.country AS name, count(*) AS value
